source: public: EA113 1.8T 20V petrol (engines AGU/AUM/AUQ/AWT/AWP/BAM/APX) runs Bosch ME7.5 (ME7.1/ME7.1.1 variants) — one of the most widely-documented VAG petrol ECUs in the tuning community.
notes: 1.8T 20V petrol. part_numbers keys '06A906032'/'06A906018' = 06A-platform engine-electronics prefixes (engine-family scope, not SW-unique). 0x7E0 assumes CAN UDS (late cars); the earliest ME7.5 cars are K-line — confirm per vehicle. ME7 is a listed OpenTune petrol target but is NOT in the solved-checksum matrix; this entry is for identification only.

source: public: EA113 2.0 FSI/TFSI petrol (naturally-aspirated FSI: BLX/BLR/BVY; turbo TFSI: BWA/BPY/BWE/CDLA) runs Bosch MED9.1 (TFSI) / MED9.5.1 (FSI). Widely documented.
notes: 2.0 FSI/TFSI (EA113) petrol. part_numbers key '06F906' = 06F engine-electronics prefix (engine-family scope). MED9.1 (direct-injection turbo) vs MED9.5.1 (NA FSI) split by induction; family lists both as a candidate set. 0x7E0 CAN UDS. MED9 is not in OpenTune's solved-checksum matrix; identification only.

notes: 2.0 TSI (EA888 gen1/2) petrol. part_numbers keys '06J906'/'06H906' = engine-electronics prefixes (engine-family scope). Simos-8 vs MED17.5 split by market/MY and is NOT pinned (candidate set). 0x7E0 CAN UDS. Identification only (not in solved-checksum matrix).
